summary: SOLAI Limited, a foreign private issuer formerly known as BIT Mining and 500.com, filed a Form 6-K disclosing that CEO Xianfeng Yang resigned effective September 30, 2026. The filing states the departure did not result from any disagreement with the company over operations, policies or practices. No successor, interim appointment, severance terms or board recommendation was disclosed. The report carries no transaction terms, advisors or structural mechanics. What to watch: whether an interim or permanent CEO is named promptly, any subsequent 6-K or 20-F disclosure on leadership and strategy, and governance signals given the company's history of name and business changes.
